tried.summary:
All three prototypes are ported as entries with group 'tried' after 'split': softfold "Blended planes", axisbulb "Bulbs about the axis", pillow "Pillow" (one entry, two layouts). The seven existing entries are untouched (diff against base12a: 0 lines removed or changed, 5 added blocks). Test page dist/r12-tried.html, built 11:36 with the prescribed command. Work took 32 minutes (11:11 to 11:43).

Measured on the final build: no console errors in any run; all ten entries draw a Mandelbrot solid and the Julia set c = -1 (22 pictures incl. Pillow's second layout, contact sheet out/r12/tried/sheet.png, each 11.8 to 58.3 % non-background); MATH on z = 0 against the flat complex power at n = 2, 3, -1 on 2,014 points: the three new entries at starting dials are exact (worst 3.6e-15, output z exactly 0); shader against MATH for the new entries: worst 4.0e-4, none over 2e-3; 45 further drawings (8 equation presets, powers 3, 8, -1, 2.5, Julia, Kleinian, 2D view under each new entry): 0 failed.

Time after loading (least of 3, fresh Chrome each): first picture fully drawn 2.95 s (v12a) against 2.98 s (mine); every program prepared in idle time 29.25 s against 38.92 s, so about 10 s more for three entries, on noisy runs (v12a 44.0/29.3/35.3 s, mine 40.1/38.9/41.5 s).

Where the verdict stands: the page draws name, tag, formula, about, then the params. So the short verdict is in `tag` (the line under the name, visible for every entry) and the full "Tried for ... Why it fails ..." text is in `about`; params[0] is a note "How it works". This differs from a literal "note as params[0] holds the verdict" and is deliberate.

Found on the way: the 2D view draws a fringe around two slices that are exact in the maths (creased Pillow 4.5 % and 7.0 % extra solid pixels, Bulbs at multiplier 5 27.6 % and 44.1 %, none missing). The entries' slice texts say so. The verdict sentences themselves come from the prototypes' NOTES.md (measured by earlier engineers on base4); I re-measured only what is listed under done.

page.summary:
All five page items are done and measured on dist/r12-page.html (built 11:46 with --base base12a and only my files; I checked that the page holds the frozen base12a copies of 10-approaches, 25-colour, 30-shaders, 40-render). tools/smoke-v12.json (58 steps) passes on it: exit code 0, no console errors. Took about 40 minutes.

What changed for the user: (1) the Approach list stands under the headings of APPROACH_GROUPS (Sphere inversions, Quaternions, Angle rules, Side by side; a "Tried, and kept for the record" heading appears by itself once that group has entries; a group without entries shows nothing).
